patterns.comment: Any comment without an @effect/effect directive stays a plain comment: no special highlighting.
patterns.name: comment.block.f-flat-minor

effectInner.comment: Sub-patterns applied inside @effect / effect / legacy-== block comments only. Ordinary comments keep the plain comment.block scope above.

patterns.comment: {...} is a human-readable note, not parsed: swallow it whole so variable names inside do not leak into the variable scope.
patterns.name: comment.note.effect.f-flat-minor

patterns.comment: Effect word name with colon: dup:, swap:, %:, <<:, .:, ?:, cons:, zero?:, ... (any single token, including symbolic words).
patterns.name: entity.name.function.effect.f-flat-minor

patterns.comment: ERROR is a keyword (the failure marker in `else ERROR`), not a variable.
patterns.name: constant.language.error.effect.f-flat-minor

patterns.comment: #R is shorthand for R.length (the length of the named rest ..R).
patterns.name: variable.other.rest-length.effect.f-flat-minor

patterns.comment: Named rests (..R, ..S), the unnamed rest (...), and the Unicode ellipsis (…).
patterns.name: variable.other.rest.effect.f-flat-minor

patterns.comment: == is the input/output separator; -- is the quotation-effect separator in [..R -- ..S].
patterns.name: keyword.operator.effect-separator.f-flat-minor

patterns.comment: Lean-operator function-call spellings used in ensures/where witnesses.
patterns.name: support.function.effect.f-flat-minor

patterns.comment: Uppercase variables (new syntax): A, B, N, LO, HI, ...
patterns.name: variable.other.effect.f-flat-minor

patterns.comment: Lowercase identifiers (old-syntax variables/words, e.g. `a b swap == b a`, `_loop`, and literal quotations like [swap]): the word/variable split is ambiguous in the old form, so both share the variable scope.
patterns.name: variable.other.effect.f-flat-minor

patterns.comment: Arithmetic, comparison, bitwise/shift, Lean-operator spellings, logic symbols, and conditionals inside effects; same scope as in code.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.f-flat-minor
